articles.title: British father fined for causing his two-year-old son's death in Cyprus hotel fall
articles.description: Joshua Foster "lost control" of his son while showing him the view of a water park from a window.

articles.title: Children aged 5, 8 and 11 killed in US school shooting before suspect shot by bystander
articles.description: A teacher was also killed in the attack at the Silver Rail Elementary School in the city of Bend, Oregon, police say.

articles.title: Community 'heartbroken and horrified' after Oregon school shooting
articles.description: A 16-year-old killed three children and a teacher at a primary school in Oregon before he was killed by a bystander, police say.

articles.title: Banks expect to be hit with higher taxes in Budget
articles.description: Senior banking executives have told the BBC they expect to be "on the menu" in the chancellor's Budget tax later this month.
